facts.subject: HYPO_BULK
facts.fact: Sodium hypochlorite delivered to Mod B is 12.5 percent; it is received at the chemical unloading area and piped into an outdoor 6500-gallon bulk tank stored at atmospheric pressure.

locator.paragraph: chemical storage and transfer; continues on page 8

facts.subject: HYPO_DAY
facts.fact: Operators pipe sodium hypochlorite from the bulk tank to a smaller day tank inside the Mod B building.

locators.paragraph: chemical storage and transfer; continues on page 8

facts.subject: HYPO_PROCESS
facts.fact: Sodium hypochlorite is transferred from the day tank into an unnamed process vessel when needed.

facts.subject: ACID_DAY
facts.fact: Thirty-percent sulfuric acid is received at the chemical unloading area in an outdoor 8500-gallon day tank.

facts.subject: ACID_DAY
facts.fact: Operators transfer sulfuric acid directly from the day tank into the process; the destination equipment is unnamed.

facts.subject: LI_HYPO
facts.fact: A sodium hypochlorite tank level indicator signals an alarm in the control system near tank capacity, notifying operators of high level. The transfer does not stop automatically because the system was not configured for that function.
